summary: Master scenario-based risk and opportunity planning to build resilience, capture strategic upside, and drive continuity. 5-day intermediate course with hands-on
lede: Scenario-Based Risk and Opportunity Planning helps professionals explore uncertain futures through realistic narratives, impact analysis, adaptive response protocols, dynamic simulations, and clear risk communication. The course builds a structured approach for testing decision resilience while identifying both emerging threats and strategic opportunities. You will create three scenario narratives, calculate Expected Monetary Value, develop contingency plans with triggers and roles, conduct tabletop simulations using real-time injects, and update risk registers with scenario-based insights. Hands-on exercises also introduce AI-driven early warning systems and TCFD alignment, while addressing constraints such as limited budgets, regulatory complexity, and technology adoption gaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who must lead risk and opportunity planning in dynamic, uncertain environments. It is ideal for intermediate-level practitioners with 2-5 years of experience in risk-related roles. Risk Manager:

Cybersecurity Specialist: Develop threat scenarios and incident
Climate Risk Analyst: Apply TCFD frameworks
Audit Manager: Review scenario integration into enterprise

modules: Foundations of Scenario-Based Risk and Opportunity Thinking
Designing Robust and Realistic Risk Scenarios
Assessing Impact and Probability in Scenarios
Building Mitigation and Opportunity Response Strategies
Running Simulations and Testing Decision Resilience
Integrating Scenarios into Enterprise Risk Management
Communicating Risk and Opportunity to Stakeholders
Advanced Applications in Emerging Risk Domains
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of risk management principles and basic familiarity with operational roles. A laptop with Excel is recommended for quantitative exercises. No coding or advanced statistics required.
